title: Two Exits Past Ardmore
subject: waiting in a truck outside a diner on I-35
caption: Stadium country with a modern pop mix. Pedal steel used as a held texture rather than a solo, clean Telecaster on muted downstrokes, upright-feeling bass with a tight modern sub, real drum kit close-miked with room on the snare only. Dry conversational female lead, doubled only on the hook, no reverb wash. 88 BPM, D major. Patient, stubborn, unsentimental. No pop, no synth, no gang vocals, no key change.
lyrics:
[Intro - pedal steel, one held note]

[Chorus]
Two exits past Ardmore I keep the truck running
Heater on, radio down, nobody coming
You said you'd be out by ten, it's a quarter to one
I'll give it one more song

[Verse 1]
Laminated menu, corner curled up from the steam
Ice machine drops a load every twenty minutes like it's keeping time
Dwayne left a twenty and a name that isn't his
Tulsa's three hours if I don't stop

[Chorus]
Two exits past Ardmore I keep the truck running
Heater on, radio down, nobody coming
You said you'd be out by ten, it's a quarter to two
I'll give it one more song

[Instrumental Break - pedal steel]

[Verse 2]
Mama kept her apron folded in the glovebox
Said a woman ought to have somewhere to put her hands
I've been wiping down a counter that I do not own
In a town that spells my last name wrong

[Outro - drums drop out, slide only]
I'll give it one more song
I'll give it one more song
